name: Delicious Celestial Tea Crisp
desc: A novel take on Wangxiao Cakes. A delicate bitterness from the Adeptea gradually blooms at the back of the tongue into a deep sweetness before giving way to an almost woody finish with the faint aroma of roasted tea. Truly a recipe worthy of two master chefs!

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 320 and CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
